curiosities: Its top screen shows 3D without glasses, with a slider to turn it down or off.
It plays almost every Nintendo DS game.
StreetPass swapped data with other 3DS consoles nearby, even asleep in a pocket.
The 2DS dropped the 3D and the hinge, for younger children.
It launched in Japan on 26 February 2011.
Five months after launch Nintendo cut its US price from $249.99 to $169.99, and gave early buyers 20 free games.
Two cameras on the back take 3D photos.
Its Circle Pad was the first analogue stick on a Nintendo handheld.
The New Nintendo 3DS of 2014 added a C-stick and steadier 3D that follows the player's face.
Pokémon X and Y, in 2013, were the first main Pokémon games fully in 3D.
Its eShop stopped selling games in March 2023.
